{{Quote|Princess, we're picking up a ship approaching rapidly. We suspect it's ''hostile''.''"<br />"''An Imperial ship? How did they find us?''"<br />"''Just chance. We make a pretty big blip on the scanners. We're diverting to ''intercept''.|The Rebel commander and Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="SOTE1" />}}
A '''Human''' served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding]] a [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Haven)|GR-75 medium transport]] as part of the main [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] regrouped at the Rebellion's deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]] beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]], where its secret location was soon discovered by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruiser]]. The Rebel [[Commander/Legends|commander]] directed the fleet's subsequent [[Skirmish at Haven|attack]] on the encroaching Imperial [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], helping to [[Space warfare/Legends|destroy]] the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruiser]] before it could relay the fleet's position. With the Rebels' secrecy nonetheless compromised, the commander altered the fleet's course back toward the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane.

==Biography==
===Imperial intrusion===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Wedge!'' We have confirmation! It's an Imperial ''Strike cruiser!'' It's essential that it does not escape to give away our position!''"<br />"''My friend, you're singing our song!|The Rebel commander and Wedge Antilles of Rogue Squadron|<ref name="SOTE1" />}}
[[File:RunningForIt-SOTE1.png|thumb|left|300px|The Rebel commander directs the Alliance Fleet's attack on the Imperial Strike cruiser.]]
In the aftermath of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] defeat at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="C-3PO">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] regrouped at a predetermined rendezvous point far beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]],<ref name="C-3PO" /> codenamed [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Haven]].<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] tattered remnants desperately sought sanctuary and new allies in their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Haven)|one]] of the Alliance Fleet's [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]].<ref name="SOTE1" />

Rebel Alliance [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|heroes]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] arrived at the rendezvous point after escaping the Empire's [[Occupation of Bespin|seizure]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], which saw their ally [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. As Skywalker and Organa recovered from their travails aboard the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], Calrissian soon departed the fleet in the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in search of Solo,<ref name="C-3PO" /> ultimately planning to rendezvous with his comrades on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Yet it was mere [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after Calrissian's departure that an Imperial [[Unidentified Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class cruiser]] happened upon the Alliance Fleet's position.<ref name="C-3PO" /> Reporting to Organa from aboard their GR-75 medium [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the Rebel [[Commander/Legends|commander]] announced that the fleet was diverting to intercept its hostile visitor.<ref name="SOTE1" />

===Strike cruiser eliminated===
{{Quote|Princess, I'm altering our course. Just as a precaution. It may mean some delay if you still intend to go to ''Tatooine''.''"<br />"''I understand. The safety of the fleet must come first.|The Rebel commander and Leia Organa, following the elimination of the Imperial Strike cruiser|<ref name="SOTE1" />}}
The Rebel commander directed the ensuing [[Skirmish at Haven|skirmish]], urgently tasking the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] with eliminating the Imperial [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruiser]] before it could report the Alliance Fleet's position. By employing [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] measures, the fleet prevented the Strike [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] from sending out a transmission even as the Imperial [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] dispatched a number of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] to meet Rogue Squadron. Both the commander's transport and the Rogues [[Space warfare/Legends|exchanged fire]] with the TIEs, quickly dispatching the enemy fighters but prompting the Strike cruiser to turn and flee. The Strike cruiser's decision to divert full power to its rear [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] as it fled blocked pursuing fire from the commander's transport but merely left the rest of the ship vulnerable. Rogue Squadron exploited the opening and destroyed the Imperial Strike cruiser.<ref name="SOTE1" />

[[File:AlteringCourse-SOTE1.png|thumb|right|300px|Informing Leia Organa of the fleet's course change]]
Despite their victory, the Rebels' secrecy had been compromised.<ref name="C-3PO" /> The commander altered the fleet's course as a precaution,<ref name="SOTE1" /> and the armada soon broke formation and headed back toward the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane.<ref name="C-3PO" /> Speaking to Organa aboard the ''Redemption'' via [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]], the commander explained that their decision might well delay the princess's plans to journey to Tatooine, but Organa understood that the fleet's safety was the top priority.<ref name="SOTE1" />

==Personality and traits==
The Rebel commander had shaggy, [[Color/Legends|light-brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]; brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]; and light skin. The commander also wore a beard.<ref name="SOTE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel commander first appeared in the [[Shadows of the Empire 1|first issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse's]] [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series,<ref name="SOTE1" /> published on [[May 7]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54543/star_wars_shadows_of_the_empire_1996_1|text=Star Wars: Shadows Of The Empire (1996) #1}}</ref> The series was written by [[John Wagner]] and illustrated by [[Kilian Plunkett]].<ref name="SOTE1" />
